meta.title: Abo turi bo: ikigo cy'ikoranabuhanga
meta.description: Itsinda rimwe i Kigali rikora design, software, mudasobwa n'ubufasha bwa IT. Menya abari inyuma ya Linse na MacyePay n'uko dukorana n'ibigo.

hero.title: Twubaka urwego rwa digitale rw’ibigo bikura.

story.heading: Ikipe imwe ku byo ikigo cyawe gikeneye byose.

story.label: Amateka yacu
story.text: Linse ni ikigo cy’ikoranabuhanga gikorera i Kigali. Twatangiye turi sitidiyo nto ikora porogaramu, kandi ibigo twakoreraga byakomezaga kubaza ikibazo kimwe: ni nde uzatuma ibi byose bikorana?

scope.label: Ibyo dukora
scope.text: Ni yo mpamvu twaguye ibikorwa byacu. Uyu munsi dukora porogaramu zihariye, dusohora ibicuruzwa byacu bwite, dukwirakwiza ibikoresho by’umwuga kandi ducunga IT ku masezerano. Ikipe imwe, umuntu umwe wo kuvugana na we, n’ihame rimwe kuri byose: bigomba gukora.

serve.label: Abo dukorera
serve.text: Dukorana n’abacuruzi, ibigo by’imari, amavuriro, amashuri n’ibigo bya leta mu Rwanda no mu karere. Igice kinini cy’akazi kacu ni uguhuza: gutuma sisitemu zisanzwe, ibicuruzwa bishya n’ibikoresho bikoreshwa bihanahana amakuru mu buryo bwizewe.

software.title: Porogaramu zihariye
software.text: Igishushanyo, imbuga, apulikasiyo na sisitemu bikozwe uko ubishaka.

publishing.title: Gusohora porogaramu zacu
publishing.text: Ibicuruzwa dushoramo imari kandi duha abandi uburenganzira bwo kubikoresha.

hardware.title: Kugurisha no gukwirakwiza ibikoresho
hardware.text: Ibikoresho bishakwa, bigezwa ku bakiriya kandi bikitabwaho mu gihugu hose.

services.title: Serivisi za IT
services.text: Ubufasha, imiyoboro, cloud n’umutekano, ku masezerano.

2022.title: Twashingiwe i Kigali
2022.text: Linse itangira ari sitidiyo ikora imbuga na sisitemu ku bigo byo mu gihugu.

2024.title: MacyePay
2024.text: Dusohora igicuruzwa cyacu cya mbere: kwishyura mu byiciro hamwe no kugaruza mu buryo bw’amategeko.

2026.title: Linsetech
2026.text: Porogaramu, ibicuruzwa, ibikoresho na serivisi za IT ahantu hamwe.

quote.text: Ntitugurisha porogaramu, ibikoresho cyangwa ubufasha. Tugurisha ko, ku wa mbere mu gitondo, byose bikora.
quote.name: Uwashinze & Umuyobozi Mukuru

people.statement: Linse iyobowe n’abantu bubaka, batanga kandi bakita ku byo bagurisha. Twibanda ku kwizerwa, ku nshingano, ku busobanuro no ku serivisi.
people.bio2: Amateka ye yuzuye n’ifoto bizashyirwa hano bikimara kuboneka.

partners.sub: Dutanga kandi twita ku bikoresho by’umwuga, tukubaka ku mbuga abakiriya bacu basanzwe bakoresha.
